resources.string: Create reusable key
Continue with Google

Authorize YouTube to create or retrieve a reusable RTMP key. No events are created and the SpikeStream server does not store Google access tokens. Before streaming, configure the broadcast as Public in YouTube Studio: the key does not set video visibility.
Key ready. Before streaming, set Public visibility in YouTube Studio.
Key recovered. The initial event ended or was removed: prepare the broadcast in YouTube Studio. SpikeStream does not create another event.
Video made for kids
This choice applies to matches created with this destination. Select it if children are the intended audience, not simply because young athletes are playing.
Enable live streaming on your YouTube channel first, then retry.
Sign in and authorize SpikeStream to create the YouTube setup.
Select the account for the YouTube channel to configure.
YouTube API quota exhausted. Retry after the quota resets.
Setup is already running for this channel. Wait and retry.
The key is busy or bound to another event. Wait for the previous broadcast to end, or check and end the event in YouTube Studio.
The configured key was removed on YouTube. Check the channel in Studio.
Creation is not confirmed yet. Wait and retry: we will look for the same setup without creating duplicates. Contact support if it persists.
The event settings have changed. Check visibility and automatic start/stop in YouTube Studio.
Choose an RTMP key to reuse for your matches.
Use an existing key
Import a key already configured on your channel.
Create a reusable key in the app. Set broadcast visibility in YouTube Studio.
This match broadcast has ended. Create a new match to start another event.
Automatic match unavailable. Return to the match list and check your account.
Preparing broadcast…
Automatic mode: Start prepares a public event. Stop ends it on YouTube after about a minute.
YouTube · Automatic
YouTube · Direct connection

For direct connection: 1. Open Studio and select Stream. 2. Prepare the stream and select Public. 3. Return here and import the key using Direct connection. Test two successive broadcasts before relying on reused settings.
